apiDescriptions./ex: This API demonstrates some of MockAPI's capabilities.

endpoints.name: Hello from MockAPI
endpoints.description: Returns a static JSON greeting with 200 OK and an X-Mock-Source header. Use this endpoint to verify connectivity and inspect a successful JSON response.

endpoints.name: Create an order
endpoints.description: Simulates successful order creation with 201 Created, a fixed JSON response for order 42, and a Location header pointing to /ex/orders/42. The request body is ignored; no order is stored or changed.

endpoints.name: Rate limited response
endpoints.description: Demonstrates rolling-window rate limiting: up to four requests in a 10-second window return 200 OK with an accepted JSON response; additional requests return 429 Too Many Requests with a JSON error and Retry-After: 10. The dashboard preselects five requests to demonstrate the limit. Both responses include repeated X-Mock-Source header values.

endpoints.name: Delete an order
endpoints.description: Simulates successful deletion of order 42 with 204 No Content and an empty response body. No order is actually deleted; repeated requests return the same configured response.

endpoints.name: Redirect to hello
endpoints.description: Returns 302 Found with Location: /ex/hello and an empty body to demonstrate an HTTP redirect. Clients that follow redirects automatically receive the destination endpoint's 200 OK JSON greeting.

endpoints.name: Server error
endpoints.description: Always returns 500 Internal Server Error with a static JSON error body. Use this endpoint to test how clients handle server failures without causing a real application error.

endpoints.name: Abort the connection
endpoints.description: Immediately aborts the connection without sending an HTTP status, headers, or body. Use this endpoint to test transport-failure handling rather than HTTP error-response handling.
